findings.title: IAM Role Available to Compute Service That Can Escalate Privileges
findings.impact: An attacker with access to the compute service can gain administrative access.
findings.description: The IAM Role sample-instance-role can be assumed by ec2.amazonaws.com and can reach the IAM Role sample-admin-role via iam:PassRole.
findings.recommendation: Restrict iam:PassRole on sample-instance-role to the roles it needs.

findings.title: Privilege Escalation via Lambda Function Update
findings.impact: A principal can alter a function that runs with a more privileged role.
findings.description: The IAM User sample-build-user can call lambda:UpdateFunctionCode on a function running as sample-deploy-role.
findings.recommendation: Separate the ability to update function code from the deploy role.

findings.title: Principals With Administrator Access
findings.impact: Broad administrative access widens the blast radius of a credential compromise.
findings.description: The IAM Role sample-admin-role has the AdministratorAccess policy attached.
findings.recommendation: Scope the policy to the actions the role actually performs.
